trainer/30298.htm.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Welcome. What brings you here? My name's Pinter, and I'm one of the proud dwarves who has carried on this family business for three generations now! I'm sure I can do anything you ask.

links.text: Bestow special ability on a weapon
View information about the lord and tax rate

trainer/30298-1.htm.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Welcome. What brings you here? My name's Pinter, and I'm one of the proud dwarves who has carried on this family business for three generations now! I'm sure I can do anything you ask.

links.text: Bestow special ability on a weapon
View information about the lord and tax rate

trainer/30298-4.htm.text: Blacksmith Pinter: You wish to remove seals on gloves, boots, or accessories? Just say the word.

links.text: Release seal on B-grade gloves and boots.
Put seal back on B-grade gloves and boots.
Put seal back on A-grade armor.

trainer/30298-5.htm.text: Blacksmith Pinter: You wish to augment an item? Well, you've come to the right place!

trainer/30298-noteach.htm.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Hmm, I cannot teach you. I only teach Dwarf Fighters and Artisans. Screw your head on straight and go find the right Master for you.

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-02b.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Hmm, how strange...!? You should've already gotten the special Armor for Academy members from Blacksmith Newyear in Schuttgart! (Characters who have undertaken 'To Lead and Be Led' are not permitted to take on this quest.)
when: state CREATED|STARTED; q123 != null

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-02a.htm.text: Blacksmith Pinter: It seems you've already gotten some of the special Armor for Academy members from Blacksmith Newyear in Schuttgart! (Characters who have undertaken 'To Lead and Be Led' are not permitted to take on this quest.)
when: state CREATED|COMPLETED; !((q123 != null) && q123.isStarted()); q123 != null

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-01.htm.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Have you heard? A new type of Armor has been designed exclusively for members of the Clan Academy ! Do you want some? I'd be happy to make it for you, just say the word!
when: state CREATED; level >= 19; !((q123 != null) && q123.isStarted()); !((q123 != null) && q123.isCompleted()); player.getPledgeType() == -1; player.getSponsor() > 0

links.text: "Please make some new Armor for me."

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-02.htm.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Have you heard? A new type of Armor has been designed exclusively for members of the Clan Academy ! Do you want some? Uh oh, it seems you're not ready for it yet... (This quest is limited to sponsored Clan Academy members of level 19 and above.)
when: state CREATED; !((q123 != null) && q123.isStarted()); !((q123 != null) && q123.isCompleted()); !((player.getLevel() >= MIN_LEVEL) && (player.getPledgeType() == -1) && (player.getSponsor() > 0))

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-04.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: You must slaughter the Maille Lizardmen and their Scouts and Guards in the Maille Lizardman Barracks and bring me 10 bottles of their blood . I can't make the special Armor without it! Get going!
when: state STARTED; memo 1; !hasItemsAtLimit(player, BLOOD_OF_MAILLE_LIZARDMAN)

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-05.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Good job! Now I'll need some Crystals: D-Gra... Oh, I'm getting ahead of myself! What kind of Armor is it that you want?
when: state STARTED; memo 1; hasItemsAtLimit(player, BLOOD_OF_MAILLE_LIZARDMAN)

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-06a.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Go and ask your Sponsor to bring me 922 D-Grade Crystals! Stop whining! I'm not running a charity here! What? You don't have a Sponsor? Why the hell didn't you say something earlier? Come back when you're sponsored!
when: state STARTED; memo 2; player.getSponsor() == 0; qs.getMemoStateEx(1) == 1

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-06b.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Go and ask your Sponsor to bring me 771 D-Grade Crystals. Stop whining! I'm not running a charity here! What? You don't have a Sponsor? Why the hell didn't you say something earlier? Come back when you're sponsored!
when: state STARTED; memo 2; player.getSponsor() == 0; !qs.getMemoStateEx(1) == 1; qs.getMemoStateEx(1) == 2

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-06c.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Go and ask your Sponsor to bring me 771 D-Grade Crystals. Stop whining! I'm not running a charity here! What? You don't have a Sponsor? Why the hell didn't you say something earlier? Come back when you're sponsored!
when: state STARTED; memo 2; player.getSponsor() == 0; !qs.getMemoStateEx(1) == 1; !qs.getMemoStateEx(1) == 2; qs.getMemoStateEx(1) == 3

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-07.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Hmmm, did you bring your Sponsor? Well, who is it? Tell him to come and see me!
when: state STARTED; memo 2; !player.getSponsor() == 0; Util.checkIfInRange(1500, npc, sponsor, true)

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-06.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Go and ask your Sponsor to bring me 922 D-Grade Crystals . Stop whining! I'm not running a charity here! By the way... You must return with your Sponsor . How else will I know who to make the Armor for?
when: state STARTED; memo 2; !player.getSponsor() == 0; !Util.checkIfInRange(1500, npc, sponsor, true); qs.getMemoStateEx(1) == 1

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-06d.html.text: Go and ask your Sponsor to bring 771 D-Grade Crystals . Stop whining! I'm not running a charity here! Oh, by the way... You've got to come back with your Sponsor ! How else will I know who to make the Armor for?
when: state STARTED; memo 2; !player.getSponsor() == 0; !Util.checkIfInRange(1500, npc, sponsor, true); !qs.getMemoStateEx(1) == 1; qs.getMemoStateEx(1) == 2

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-06e.html.text: Go and ask your Sponsor to bring 771 D-Grade Crystals . Stop whining! I'm not running a charity here! Oh, by the way... You've got to come back with your Sponsor ! How else will I know who he's sponsoring?
when: state STARTED; memo 2; !player.getSponsor() == 0; !Util.checkIfInRange(1500, npc, sponsor, true); !qs.getMemoStateEx(1) == 1; !qs.getMemoStateEx(1) == 2

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-15.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Well, I have all the ingredients I need, but I have one more favor to ask of you... I want to test the bond between you and your Sponsor. Go to the Maille Lizardmen Barracks and defeat the King of the Araneid and bring me all 8 of his legs ! Also, you must defeat the King of the …
when: state STARTED; memo 3

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-16.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Go to the Maille Lizardmen Barracks and defeat the King of the Araneid and bring me his 8 legs . You must defeat him while your Sponsor looks on ! This of this as an opportunity to prove yourself to him! Naturally, if you get in trouble, he'll be there to help you! This experienc…
when: state STARTED; memo 4; !hasItemsAtLimit(player, LEG_OF_KING_ARANEID)

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-17.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Hmmm? What do you think? Was your Sponsor impressed? Good! Here's your Armor, as promised! Wear it in good health, my friend!
when: state STARTED; memo 4; hasItemsAtLimit(player, LEG_OF_KING_ARANEID)

Q00216_TrialOfTheGuildsman/30298-02.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Trial of the Guildsman? Deco beads? Hey, everyone has problems, I've got mine, too! I am swamped with too much work! 30 Mithril Breastplates and 30 Bastard Swords! The dogs of war are howling! How can I possibly finish all of this?
when: state STARTED; has items 3122,3124

Q00216_TrialOfTheGuildsman/30298-06.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: How many beads have you collected? That is not enough! Are you sure that you are looking in the Wastelands? Hurry and collect 70 Amber Beads . I will see to the preparations for making the decoration bead. Hurry back with the beads!
when: state STARTED; has items 3122,3135; lacks items 3124; !hasItemsAtLimit(player, AMBER_BEAD)

Q00216_TrialOfTheGuildsman/30298-07.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Good job! Aren't they beautiful! First separate 50 of them...! Now, shall I start? I will drill these and make splendid Journeyman Decoration Beads . OK, all done! Here are your beads. Good luck!
when: state STARTED; has items 3122,3135; lacks items 3124; hasItemsAtLimit(player, AMBER_BEAD)

Q00216_TrialOfTheGuildsman/30298-08.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Good luck on the Trial of Guild, my friend! Could I bother you for a drink if you are passing by? I will pay if you can't, ha ha. I have much work to do, and little time to do it.
when: state STARTED; has items 3122,3138,3139; lacks items 3124,3135

Q00418_PathOfTheArtisan/30298-01.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Ah, this letter! Have you really brought this from Kluto? It is beyond my power, what should I do ...
when: state STARTED; has items 1633,1638; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted())

Q00418_PathOfTheArtisan/30298-04.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: I see you have not found the stolen item yet. Please hurry and find it. My life depends upon your success. You know who the thieves are, right? We strongly suspect the Vuku Orc Fighters . Hurry and catch them!
when: state STARTED; has items 1633,1639; lacks items 1633,1638,1640; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted())

Q00418_PathOfTheArtisan/30298-05.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Yes, this is it! Thank you so much. Let me look it over once more, then I hope you will take it to Kluto .
when: state STARTED; has items 1633,1639,1640; lacks items 1633,1638; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted()); !(hasQuestItems(player, PASS_1ST_CERTIFICATE, FOOTPRINT_OF_THIEF) && !hasQuestItems(player, STOLEN_SECRET_BOX))

links.text: Look here, shouldn't my efforts receive some kind of compensation?

Q00418_PathOfTheArtisan/30298-07.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Go and take the item to him. Isn't that enough compensation? I tell you again, this task is an absolute secret. If things go wrong, I'll be ruined for the rest of my life!
when: state STARTED; has items 1633,1634,1641; lacks items 1633,1638,1639,1640; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted()); !(hasQuestItems(player, PASS_1ST_CERTIFICATE, FOOTPRINT_OF_THIEF) && !hasQuestItems(player, STOLEN_SECRET_BOX))

Q00708_PathToBecomingALordGludio/30298-0.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Aren't you a member of the Gludio Castle Clan? What brings you here? I'm very busy, so unless it's important, leave me alone!
when: state STARTED; !npc.isMyLord(player); qsLeader != null; qsLeader.hasMemoState(); qsLeader.getMemoState() <= 3

Q00708_PathToBecomingALordGludio/30298-0.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Aren't you a member of the Gludio Castle Clan? What brings you here? I'm very busy, so unless it's important, leave me alone!

Q00708_PathToBecomingALordGludio/30298-0.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Aren't you a member of the Gludio Castle Clan? What brings you here? I'm very busy, so unless it's important, leave me alone! (This quest may only be undertaken by castle clan members designated as stewards.)
when: state STARTED; memo 4; !npc.isMyLord(player); qsLeader != null; !(qsLeader.hasMemoState() && (qsLeader.getMemoState() <= 3)); !player.getObjectId() == qs.getMemoStateEx(1)

Q00708_PathToBecomingALordGludio/30298-0.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Were you able to obtain the materials that I requested? If so, please give them to me. Our work cannot be halted even for a single day.
when: state STARTED; item 1867 >= 100; item 1865 >= 100; item 1869 >= 100; item 1879 >= 50; !npc.isMyLord(player); qsLeader != null; !(qsLeader.hasMemoState() && (qsLeader.getMemoState() <= 3)); (qsLeader.getMemoState() % 10) == 5

Q00708_PathToBecomingALordGludio/30298-0.text: Blacksmith Pinter: What are you doing? Unless you supply us with materials, the reconstruction work will have to stop. We are relying on you. Don't let us down! You do know what's needed, right? The materials that we need now are 100 pieces of animal skin, 100 varnish, 100 iron ore, and 50 cokes .
when: state STARTED; !npc.isMyLord(player); qsLeader != null; !(qsLeader.hasMemoState() && (qsLeader.getMemoState() <= 3)); (qsLeader.getMemoState() % 10) == 5

Q00708_PathToBecomingALordGludio/30298-1.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Thanks to you, our reconstruction work went smoothly. Thank you, my friend!
when: state STARTED; !npc.isMyLord(player); qsLeader != null; !(qsLeader.hasMemoState() && (qsLeader.getMemoState() <= 3)); !(qsLeader.getMemoState() % 10) == 5

Q00708_PathToBecomingALordGludio/30298-0.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Aren't you a member of the Gludio Castle Clan? What brings you here? I'm very busy, so unless it's important, leave me alone! (You can continue only if the castle lord is logged on.)
when: state STARTED; !npc.isMyLord(player); !qsLeader != null

Q00708_PathToBecomingALordGludio/30298-1.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Why has someone like you come looking for someone like me? (Only stewards designated by the lord may undertake this quest.)
when: state STARTED; npc.isMyLord(player); npc.isMyLord(player)

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-03.htm.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Oh really? Nothing in life is free, my friend! This will be no exception! You may as well get ready to pay through the nose for every little piece of material I need! Ha! That look on your face is priceless! You won't find this stuff easily, I can promise you that! Nothing I need…

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-05a.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Heavy Armor, eh? Make sure that's what you want, because once I get started, there's no turning back!

links.text: "I need to think about it some more."

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-05b.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Light Armor, eh? Make sure that's what you want, because once I start making it, there's no going back!

links.text: "I need to think about it some more."

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-05c.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Robe Armor, eh? Make sure that's what you want, because once I start making it, there's no going back!

links.text: "I need to think about it some more."

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-05d.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Heavy Armor it is, then! I'll need some D-Grade Crystals, but I know better than to ask a lightweight like you to bring them to me! Tell your Sponsor to bring me 922 D-Grade Crystals . Stop whining! I'm not running a charity here! Oh, by the way... You've got to come back with yo…

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-05e.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Now I can get started making the Light Armor! I'll need some D-Grade Crystals, but I know better than to ask a lightweight like you to bring them to me! Go and ask your Sponsor to bring me 771 D-Grade Crystals . Stop whining! I'm not running a charity here! Oh, by the way... You'…

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-05f.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Now I can get started making Robe Armor. I'll need some D-Grade Crystals, but I know better than to ask a lightweight like you to bring them to me! Have your Sponsor bring me 771 D-Grade Crystals. Stop whining! I'm not running a charity here! Oh, by the way... You've got to come …

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-05g.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: You need to think about it? Fine! Let me know what you decide!

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-08.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Oh, you're back! Did you bring what I asked for?

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-09.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: You claim to be a Sponsor, but you stand here alone! How am I to know who you've sponsored? Bring your apprentice with you next time!

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-10.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Ah yes, thank you! Now, I'd like to speak with your apprentice.

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-11.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: This isn't enough! Bring me 922 D-Grade Crystals .

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-11a.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: This isn't enough! Bring me 771 D-Grade Crystals .

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-12.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Now I'd like to speak with your apprentice.

Q00118_ToLeadAndBeLed/30298-14.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Stop wasting my time! I have nothing to say to you!

Q00216_TrialOfTheGuildsman/30298-03.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Stop whining! You sound like a spoiled child! You say you need a Journeyman Deco Bead? To make that we need Amber Beads . I don't have any of these. I must cast a spell on Elmore's side... It will take a few weeks..

Q00216_TrialOfTheGuildsman/30298-04.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: You think you can get the Amber Beads by yourself...? Oho! Indeed you are a Scavenger! I can tell you where to look. There are giant ants living in the Wastelands , in the southern part of Gludio. They mine the Amber Beads, which are plentiful there. To get the beads you must kil…

Q00216_TrialOfTheGuildsman/30298-05.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: You think you can get the Amber Beads by yourself? Oho! You are not even a Scavenger! Oh, well, if you want to try I can tell you where to find them.. There are giant ants living in the Wastelands , in the southern part of Gludio. They mine the Amber Beads which are plentiful in …

Q00216_TrialOfTheGuildsman/30298-05a.htm.text: Blacksmith Pinter: You will find Amber Lump after killing the worker ants. If you grind the Amber Lump as in this recipe, you can make 5 Amber Beads. Good luck!

Q00418_PathOfTheArtisan/30298-02.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Actually, Kluto asked me for something before... I kept it hidden in the corner of the blacksmith's shop for a long time, but oh dear, the item has been stolen! If I don't have it, Kluto will be terribly angry... he may seem like a gentleman but he has a temper like fire. When he…

Q00418_PathOfTheArtisan/30298-03.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Are you sure? Could you do that? If so, I can give you one clue. This is a footprint that was discovered on the floor of the blacksmith shop on the night of the robbery. I think that it is probably the footprint of the thief. Looking at the footprint, there is no doubt that it is…

Q00418_PathOfTheArtisan/30298-06.html.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Compensation ... right. Dwarves do not operate without something in return ... Hmm, what would you like? Ah, you are in the midst of taking the test of the Artisan, aren't you? If that is so, then I will give you this. However, you must not tell anyone what you have done. If this…

Q00708_PathToBecomingALordGludio/30298-0.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Ha ha ha! You want to help us? You do know the current situation of Gludio Territory, right? Destruction is everywhere; a great deal is needed if we are to rebuild. Oh, I'm sure you already know all -- what did you have in mind?

links.text: "We've come to do whatever we can to help you."

Q00708_PathToBecomingALordGludio/30298-0.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Well, I like your can-do attitude! We'll gladly accept your help. We were supposed to received some construction materials, but they are long overdue. Something must have happened. We must find out what's happened, but I can't spare anyone to investigate. Most importantly, we nee…
Blacksmith Pinter: I like your can-do attitude! But do you really think your lord will allow this? (You can proceed only if the lord is in the game.)

Blacksmith Pinter: These materials will last us for a while. Thank you! We will never forget what you have done for us here. You have the makings of a wise ruler, in fact. Are you perhaps interested in working for our territory? No? Well then, I must return to my work and let you go back to yours.

Q00708_PathToBecomingALordGludio/30298-1.text: Blacksmith Pinter: Where are the materials I asked you for? Please obtain them quickly!
Blacksmith Pinter: Did you get permission from your lord for this mission? Sorry to doubt you, but I need to be sure for both our sakes. (You can proceed only if the lord is in the game.)

common/duals_01.htm.text: Needless to say, in order to make a Dualsword, you first need two swords. They can be either Regular weapons, Standard weapons or Rare weapons. Regular weapons can only be combined with other Regular weapons, Standard weapons can only be combined with other Standard weapons, and Rare weapons can on…

common/weapon_sa_01.htm.text: Ah, so you wish to enhance your weapon! Well, it's the next-best thing to buying a new one, I say... But remember, a higher price doesn't necessarily mean a better product. There are many excellent weapons that are reasonably priced. As I'm sure you know, capabilities added to your weapon don't int…

common/crafting_01.htm.text: [Create ingredient item] Our Blacksmith Guild creates items at a very reasonable price. You may entrust your precious materials to our Blacksmiths. They have a long-standing tradition of integrity. We will do our best to serve you. The creation of the ingredient for A-grade items is the pride of ou…

links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!
